annotations.title: Like a post or comment as the brand (Facebook, Bluesky)

description: Like (or undo:true to unlike) a post or a comment AS the brand: on Facebook as the Page (a Page post id or a comment id from list_meta_posts / list_meta_comments; Meta does not allow liking a Page review), on Bluesky as the connected account (the post or reply AT-URI from list_inbox). Read back from the platform. Instagram is like_instagram; LinkedIn is react_to_linkedin_post (it takes comment URNs and every reaction type); YouTube publishes no API for liking a comment. Public: the like is visible. Free.

id.description: Facebook: a Page post id ({pageId}_{postId}) or comment id; Bluesky: the at:// URI of the post or reply

pageId.description: Facebook Page doing the liking; omit when only one Page is connected

undo.description: true to remove the brand’s like

name: like_post_or_comment
